_comment: #133 product table v1, widened for #237 accuracy. Categories are first-match: logo, poster/text, anime/illustration, photoreal portrait/product/e-commerce, then character/product consistency, else the feature default. English keywords are whole words; Chinese keywords are substrings. A keyword preceded by a negation (no / don't / 不要 / 没有) does not count. exclude blanks a phrase before matching (portrait orientation, job title, context menu). also is a list of groups that all have to hit, so bare 'photorealistic' or '写实' is not enough for a landscape. 2+ reference images are not a category here: api/mcp_tools/canvas.py sends them to image_edit multi_reference (google/nano-banana-2.1/edit, #153) because refs run on the edit path. A model missing from the catalog is an error (#712); only a model listed in the row's explicit "fallback" (string or list) stands in, logged.

skills._comment: #708/#712: per-skill model pins. Registered explicitly: the skill's model runs at its resolution; fallback runs only after the primary call fails (logged). A pinned model missing from the catalog is an error, never a silent switch to the feature default.
